features.desc_id: Solusi IoT terintegrasi untuk sistem keamanan, parkir cerdas, dan sensor alarm yang terhubung secara real-time.
features.desc_en: Integrated IoT solutions for security systems, smart parking, and real-time connected alarm sensors.
features.learn_more_title_id: Ekosistem IoT untuk Keamanan & Operasional Cerdas
features.learn_more_title_en: IoT Ecosystem for Smart Security & Operations
features.learn_more_desc_id:
Kami menghadirkan ekosistem IoT yang komprehensif untuk membantu institusi dan bisnis mengelola keamanan, parkir, dan deteksi ancaman secara otomatis.

Setiap perangkat terhubung dalam jaringan terpadu yang memungkinkan pemantauan real-time, respons insiden cepat, dan laporan otomatis langsung ke tim Anda.

Dengan arsitektur yang skalabel dan protokol industri terkini, solusi kami mudah diintegrasikan dengan infrastruktur yang sudah ada.
features.learn_more_desc_en:
We deliver a comprehensive IoT ecosystem to help institutions and businesses manage security, parking, and threat detection automatically.

Every device is connected in a unified network enabling real-time monitoring, rapid incident response, and automated reports delivered directly to your team.

With a scalable architecture and the latest industry protocols, our solutions integrate seamlessly with your existing infrastructure.

header_learn_more.desc_id: Platform keamanan berbasis IoT yang menghubungkan kamera CCTV, access control, dan sensor dalam satu dashboard terpusat. Notifikasi insiden dikirim secara otomatis ke petugas keamanan melalui aplikasi mobile.
header_learn_more.desc_en: IoT-based security platform connecting CCTV cameras, access control, and sensors in one centralized dashboard. Incident notifications are automatically pushed to security personnel via mobile app.

header_learn_more.desc_id: Manajemen parkir otomatis dengan sensor IoT per slot, pengenalan plat nomor kendaraan, dan panduan navigasi digital. Pengelola mendapatkan laporan kapasitas dan pendapatan secara real-time.
header_learn_more.desc_en: Automated parking management with per-slot IoT sensors, license plate recognition, and digital navigation guidance. Managers receive real-time capacity and revenue reports.

header_learn_more.desc_id: Jaringan sensor pintar untuk deteksi asap, kebakaran, intrusi, dan perubahan lingkungan. Sistem alarm berbasis IoT dengan respons otomatis dan eskalasi peringatan bertingkat kepada tim terkait.
header_learn_more.desc_en: Smart sensor networks for smoke, fire, intrusion, and environmental change detection. IoT-based alarm system with automated response and tiered alert escalation to the relevant teams.

benefits.desc_id: Pantau seluruh perangkat IoT dari satu dashboard terpusat, kapan saja dan di mana saja.
benefits.desc_en: Monitor all IoT devices from a single centralized dashboard, anytime and anywhere.

benefits.desc_id: Notifikasi otomatis dan eskalasi peringatan memastikan setiap insiden ditangani dalam hitungan detik.
benefits.desc_en: Automated notifications and alert escalation ensure every incident is handled within seconds.

benefits.desc_id: Otomatisasi proses keamanan dan parkir mengurangi kebutuhan tenaga manual hingga 60%.
benefits.desc_en: Automating security and parking processes reduces manual labor needs by up to 60%.

benefits.desc_id: Data dari seluruh sensor diolah menjadi laporan harian, mingguan, dan bulanan secara otomatis.
benefits.desc_en: Data from all sensors is automatically processed into daily, weekly, and monthly reports.

benefits.desc_id: Protokol standar (MQTT, HTTP, Modbus) memudahkan integrasi dengan sistem yang sudah ada.
benefits.desc_en: Standard protocols (MQTT, HTTP, Modbus) make integration with existing systems straightforward.

benefits.desc_id: Tambah ratusan perangkat baru tanpa mengganggu jaringan yang sudah berjalan.
benefits.desc_en: Add hundreds of new devices without disrupting the existing running network.

features.desc_id: Solusi AI canggih untuk pelacakan objek & kendaraan secara real-time serta analitik perjalanan berbasis kecerdasan buatan.
features.desc_en: Advanced AI solutions for real-time object & vehicle tracking and AI-based journey analytics.
features.learn_more_desc_id:
Kami mengembangkan platform kecerdasan buatan yang mampu melacak pergerakan objek, kendaraan, dan manusia secara real-time dengan akurasi tinggi.

Teknologi AI Journey kami menganalisis pola perjalanan, kepadatan lalu lintas, dan anomali pergerakan untuk membantu pengambilan keputusan operasional yang lebih cepat dan akurat.

Dengan deep learning dan computer vision terkini, setiap kamera menjadi sensor cerdas yang menghasilkan insight bernilai tinggi.
features.learn_more_desc_en:
We develop artificial intelligence platforms capable of tracking the movement of objects, vehicles, and people in real-time with high accuracy.

Our AI Journey technology analyzes travel patterns, traffic density, and movement anomalies to support faster and more accurate operational decision-making.

With the latest deep learning and computer vision, every camera becomes a smart sensor generating high-value insights.

header_learn_more.desc_id: Sistem pelacakan berbasis AI yang mampu mendeteksi dan melacak pergerakan kendaraan, orang, dan objek secara real-time dari feed CCTV. Mendukung multi-kamera dengan re-identification otomatis saat objek berpindah zona.
header_learn_more.desc_en: AI-based tracking system capable of detecting and tracing vehicle, person, and object movements in real-time from CCTV feeds. Supports multi-camera with automatic re-identification as objects move between zones.

header_learn_more.desc_id: Platform analitik perjalanan yang memetakan rute, pola kepadatan, dan waktu tempuh kendaraan maupun pejalan kaki. Menghasilkan heatmap, origin-destination matrix, dan laporan tren mobilitas untuk perencanaan operasional.
header_learn_more.desc_en: Travel analytics platform that maps routes, density patterns, and travel times for vehicles and pedestrians. Generates heatmaps, origin-destination matrices, and mobility trend reports for operational planning.

header_learn_more.desc_id: Algoritma AI yang secara otomatis mendeteksi perilaku mencurigakan, pelanggaran zona terlarang, objek tertinggal, dan kerumunan berlebihan. Peringatan dini dikirim langsung ke operator sebelum insiden berkembang.
header_learn_more.desc_en: AI algorithms that automatically detect suspicious behavior, restricted zone violations, abandoned objects, and overcrowding. Early warnings are sent directly to operators before incidents escalate.

benefits.desc_id: Model deep learning terlatih mencapai akurasi deteksi objek dan kendaraan di atas 97% dalam berbagai kondisi cahaya.
benefits.desc_en: Trained deep learning models achieve object and vehicle detection accuracy above 97% in various lighting conditions.

benefits.desc_id: Analisis video dan tracking dilakukan langsung di edge device, menghasilkan insight instan tanpa latensi tinggi.
benefits.desc_en: Video analysis and tracking are performed directly on edge devices, delivering instant insights without high latency.

benefits.desc_id: Lacak objek secara konsisten di ratusan kamera dan zona berbeda dengan re-identification otomatis.
benefits.desc_en: Track objects consistently across hundreds of cameras and different zones with automatic re-identification.

benefits.desc_id: Data perjalanan dan pola pergerakan dianalisis menjadi laporan strategis untuk optimasi operasional dan perencanaan.
benefits.desc_en: Journey data and movement patterns are analyzed into strategic reports for operational optimization and planning.

benefits.desc_id: Sistem secara proaktif mengidentifikasi perilaku mencurigakan dan mengirim peringatan sebelum insiden terjadi.
benefits.desc_en: The system proactively identifies suspicious behavior and sends alerts before incidents occur.

benefits.desc_id: Arsitektur terdistribusi mampu menangani ratusan stream video secara bersamaan dengan performa stabil.
benefits.desc_en: Distributed architecture handles hundreds of simultaneous video streams with stable performance.

features.desc_id: Pengembangan perangkat lunak custom untuk kebutuhan pemerintahan, industri, dan komersial dengan teknologi modern dan arsitektur yang skalabel.
features.desc_en: Custom software development for government, industrial, and commercial needs with modern technology and scalable architecture.
features.learn_more_title_id: Solusi Perangkat Lunak untuk Berbagai Industri
features.learn_more_desc_id:
Kami membangun perangkat lunak custom yang dirancang sesuai kebutuhan spesifik bisnis dan institusi Anda — mulai dari sistem informasi pemerintahan, aplikasi mobile, platform iklan digital, hingga solusi IoT terintegrasi.

Setiap produk dikembangkan dengan standar kualitas tinggi, arsitektur yang maintainable, dan pengalaman pengguna yang intuitif.

Tim kami berpengalaman menangani proyek skala nasional dengan kebutuhan keamanan, performa, dan keandalan tinggi.
features.learn_more_desc_en:
We build custom software tailored to the specific needs of your business and institution — from government information systems, mobile applications, digital advertising platforms, to integrated IoT solutions.

Every product is developed to high quality standards, with maintainable architecture and an intuitive user experience.

Our team has extensive experience handling national-scale projects with high security, performance, and reliability requirements.

header_learn_more.desc_id: Sistem informasi manajemen kabinet yang dirancang untuk mendigitalisasi dan menyederhanakan pengelolaan data kabinet pemerintahan. Platform ini mengintegrasikan informasi kementerian, pejabat, dan kebijakan dalam satu dashboard terpusat untuk pengambilan keputusan yang lebih efisien.
header_learn_more.desc_en: A cabinet management information system designed to digitize and streamline government cabinet data management. This platform integrates ministry, official, and policy information into a centralized dashboard for more efficient decision-making.

header_learn_more.desc_id: Aplikasi mobile untuk penghuni kawasan Modernland yang menyediakan berbagai layanan hunian dalam satu platform. Penghuni dapat mengelola unit hunian, melakukan pemesanan dan pembayaran tagihan, mengakses layanan pelayanan, serta menemukan informasi promo, berita, properti, event, marketplace, dan coworking space.
header_learn_more.desc_en: A mobile application for Modernland residential area residents that provides various housing services in one platform. Residents can manage units, make reservations and bill payments, access services, and discover promos, news, properties, events, marketplace, and coworking spaces.

header_learn_more.desc_id: Sistem periklanan LED digital untuk jaringan Kereta Commuter Indonesia (KCI). Platform ini mengelola konten iklan secara terpusat di seluruh stasiun dan gerbong kereta, dengan penjadwalan otomatis, analitik tayangan, dan kemampuan update konten secara real-time.
header_learn_more.desc_en: A digital LED advertising system for the Indonesian Commuter Train (KCI) network. This platform centrally manages ad content across all stations and train cars, with automatic scheduling, impression analytics, and real-time content update capabilities.

header_learn_more.desc_id: Sistem aplikasi keimigrasian untuk mendata kedatangan dan keberangkatan WNA dan WNI berdasarkan jenis visa. Dilengkapi pemeriksaan cekal, pengecekan Interpol, riwayat perlintasan, validasi Arrival Card, serta perhitungan denda overstay secara otomatis.
header_learn_more.desc_en: An immigration application system for recording arrivals and departures of foreign nationals and Indonesian citizens based on visa type. Features travel ban checking, Interpol verification, crossing history, Arrival Card validation, and automated overstay fine calculation.

header_learn_more.desc_id: Platform digital yang aman dan mudah digunakan untuk memperlancar proses Visa on Arrival bagi pelancong internasional. Memungkinkan pengajuan informasi, pengunggahan dokumen, dan penyelesaian pembayaran di muka untuk pemrosesan imigrasi yang lebih cepat.
header_learn_more.desc_en: A secure and user-friendly digital platform that streamlines the Visa on Arrival process for international travelers. Allows information submission, document uploading, and advance payment for faster immigration processing.

header_learn_more.desc_id: Kompor induksi pintar yang terintegrasi dengan teknologi IoT untuk kontrol memasak yang presisi dan efisien. Dilengkapi dengan sensor suhu otomatis, kontrol jarak jauh melalui aplikasi, dan fitur keamanan canggih.
header_learn_more.desc_en: A smart induction cooker integrated with IoT technology for precise and efficient cooking control. Equipped with automatic temperature sensors, remote app control, and advanced safety features.

header_learn_more.desc_id: Timbangan digital pintar yang terhubung dengan platform IoT untuk pencatatan dan analisis berat secara otomatis. Digunakan untuk berbagai keperluan industri dan komersial dengan akurasi tinggi dan integrasi ke sistem manajemen terpusat.
header_learn_more.desc_en: A smart digital scale connected to an IoT platform for automatic weight recording and analysis. Used for industrial and commercial purposes with high accuracy and integration to centralized management systems.

header_learn_more.desc_id: Solusi Smart TV berbasis IoT yang mentransformasi televisi konvensional menjadi perangkat pintar terintegrasi. Mendukung kontrol melalui aplikasi, penjadwalan konten otomatis, dan integrasi dengan ekosistem smart home.
header_learn_more.desc_en: An IoT-based Smart TV solution that transforms conventional televisions into integrated smart devices. Supports app-based control, automatic content scheduling, and smart home ecosystem integration.

benefits.desc_id: Setiap perangkat lunak dirancang dari awal sesuai proses bisnis dan kebutuhan spesifik klien, bukan template generik.
benefits.desc_en: Every software is designed from scratch to match the client's business processes and specific needs, not generic templates.

benefits.desc_id: Berpengalaman menangani sistem skala nasional untuk instansi pemerintah, BUMN, dan perusahaan swasta terkemuka.
benefits.desc_en: Experienced in handling national-scale systems for government agencies, state-owned enterprises, and leading private companies.

benefits.desc_id: Kode yang bersih, terdokumentasi, dan dibangun dengan pola arsitektur modern untuk kemudahan pengembangan jangka panjang.
benefits.desc_en: Clean, documented code built with modern architectural patterns for long-term development ease.

benefits.desc_id: Implementasi standar keamanan terkini termasuk enkripsi data, autentikasi berlapis, dan perlindungan terhadap ancaman siber.
benefits.desc_en: Implementation of the latest security standards including data encryption, multi-layer authentication, and cyber threat protection.

benefits.desc_id: Tim dedikasi tersedia untuk pemeliharaan, pembaruan fitur, dan dukungan teknis pasca-implementasi.
benefits.desc_en: Dedicated team available for maintenance, feature updates, and post-implementation technical support.

benefits.desc_id: Kemampuan integrasi dengan sistem existing melalui REST API, WebSocket, dan berbagai protokol standar industri.
benefits.desc_en: Integration capability with existing systems via REST API, WebSocket, and various industry-standard protocols.
